mechanism: Hub K(a,b,X) bounces with an LSB-first counter X over blocks d01(001)^e (grammar G). An E2 eat leaves an O2 residue '11' V that is digested (D1-D5). At the first b-block, D6 runs, in one bounce, an ordinary epoch from K(1,e+1,R) to its first left record L(k,000 Y) and leaves a^(k+1) z Y. Nests are flat (one block per level) and are incremented at half speed. Digestion consumes the whole residue, leaves one block per level, and costs O(sqrt N log N) against the budget N.
closed_gaps: Grammar G and inc on G (GI): exact recursive carry with absorption into the previous block; G closed under inc. 1200/1200 (seeds 1, 2).
Generalized eats E2g (any first-block exponent, any G rest) and E1g (any G rest): 1200/1200 each; all 1,020 orbit eats after epoch 2 to 1e11 match E1g/E2g/E0/tail rules.
Every eat after epoch 2 on the orbit to 1e11 (519 epochs, N to 12,668) is at a G word; digestion leaves >= 0.467*N of the budget (N=45), beta/N <= 0.051 for N >= 6000.
Exhaustive clean residues k <= 12 (32,760): beta_max(k) = 2^((k+9)/2)-7 (odd k), 5*2^((k+4)/2)-7 (even k), i.e. beta_max(k+2) = 2*beta_max(k)+7; a first block a^e0 adds exactly e0-1.
D6 exact: one bounce = a^(k+1) z Y with (k, 000 Y) the first left record of the epoch from K(1,e+1,R); 1200/1200 (seeds 1, 2), prediction from the rules-only model.
